  { category: 'self_study', topic: 'How to create a self-study plan for any subject', audience: 'self-directed learners', primary_keyword: 'self study plan', tone: 'practical' },

return [{ json: {
  ...selected,
  cta: 'If you want more practice, give your topic or notes/file to AI to generate a quiz at https://www.parikzen.com.',

  target_word_count: 800,
  output_format: 'markdown'
} }];
